newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine gravediggers in tombstone shootout.
newsitem.headline: Argentine gravediggers in tombstone shootout.

text.p: Argentine police arrested five gravediggers and rushed another to a hospital with gunshot wounds on Thursday, after they fought with guns and knives in a Buenos Aires cemetery over which graves they had to tend.

The state news agency Telam quoted cemetery director Jorge Costamagna saying 10 workers at the city's huge La Chacarita cemetery fought among the tombstones after a dispute over labour demarcation in the graveyard.

Costamagna said no mourners were hurt because "there were few visitors, since it all happened when the cemetery was not holding any services." There was no explanation as to why cemetery employees were carrying weapons.
